trials.claim: Tool automates new group members onboarding for every Facebook group owner
trials.claimQuote: A must-have tool for every Facebook group owner to automate new group members onboarding
trials.reasoning: Automation only works while Chrome is open and, per a reviewer, only on a laptop, so it is not fully hands-free onboarding for every group owner.

exhibits.quote: Approve members who meet your criteria and decline the rest, automatically, 24/7 while Chrome is open.
exhibits.argument: Automation only works while Chrome is open, so it is not fully hands-free for every owner.

exhibits.quote: My only complaint is that I can only approve people on my laptop using GC.
exhibits.argument: The tool cannot be used on phone, limiting which group owners can automate onboarding.

exhibits.quote: Group Collector captures every email first, syncs it to Google Sheets and your marketing tools, and welcomes new members. Automatically.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the tool automatically captures emails, syncs data, and welcomes new members.

exhibits.quote: EVERYONE who owns a group needs to get it as it makes your groups management 10x easier, and for the price that is some of the easiest time to buy back you will ever buy.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms every group owner needs it because it makes group management easier.

trials.claim: Saves Facebook Group members' data to Google Sheet
trials.claimQuote: Save Facebook Group members' data to Google Sheet
trials.reasoning: Two reviewers consistently report the Google Sheet data is jumbled and emails are not in a clean column, requiring manual sorting despite the vendor's save-to-Sheet promise.

exhibits.quote: The information on both the dashboard and connected Google Sheets is jumbled up, meaning that you will need to sort through it all manually, thus eliminating any automations.
exhibits.argument: Google Sheets data arrives jumbled and requires manual sorting, undermining the save-to-Sheet claim.

exhibits.quote: the emails are not even extracted in a clean column in the google sheet, I already reported that problem long time ago, you did not fix anything
exhibits.argument: Emails are not placed in a clean column in Google Sheets, so the Sheet export is broken.

exhibits.quote: Every member's name, email, answers, and profile data automatically flows into your Google Sheet the moment you approve them.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states member data automatically flows into Google Sheet on approval.

exhibits.quote: Fills all of my members data to the Google Sheet and Autoresponders.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the app fills members data to Google Sheet.

trials.claim: Integrates with autoresponders without using Zapier
trials.claimQuote: Integrate Facebook Group Collector with autoresponders without using Zapier
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms new members are automatically added to ConvertKit, matching the vendor's direct no-Zapier sync claim, and the prosecution exhibits do not show Zapier is required.

exhibits.quote: while also allowing me to automate adding new emails to my email list! (With a Google Sheets to my autoresponder Zap in Zapier 😉)
exhibits.argument: A long-term user still needs a Zap in Zapier to get emails to an autoresponder.

exhibits.quote: Group collector won't let me change my email so now the two won't integrate 😩
exhibits.argument: The autoresponder integration failed for this buyer because accounts could not be matched.

exhibits.quote: When you approve a member, their email and data syncs directly. No Zapier, no middleware, no extra monthly bill.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states email syncs directly to email platform with no Zapier needed.

exhibits.quote: It automatically adds my new group members to Convertkit.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms automatic sync of new members to autoresponder Convertkit.
